author: Mark Atwood
text: De-labeling human per AGENTS.md 'When NOT to file human' anti-pattern #3 (stale committed recommendation): bead body has a clear single recommended fix path (a), parent-epic comment dated 2026-05-15 03:21 UTC explicitly says 'recommended fix (path a: one-word doc-comment change)' and 'left the human label intact' was admitted as overcautious conservatism. None of the high-stakes qualifiers apply: not destructive, not a public API break (doc-comment only), not a security boundary. Two equally-plausible options NOT presented — (b) and (c) are explicitly expansion paths, not alternatives. Claiming and fixing path (a).
